experiment: YNCA-12 exploratory development: infer two retained causal operator contexts without labels
predecessor: YNCA-11 PR #1236 at c72105f947651e231d67940d4bce9a49164fca27; its source-frozen B is consumed and must not be retuned
scope: Synthetic contributor-only study; not native Yggdrasil/CKAD learning, scientific first-use, deployment or accepted-ref change
hypothesis: A top-six unordered-operator-pair posterior learned from unlabeled intervention/outcome worlds survives interference and approaches full 300-pair Bayesian predictive Brier while retaining <=6 pairs.
grammar: Exactly YNCA-11 deterministic 24 nontrivial permutation-orbit representative Boolean functions; not open-grammar invention

protocol.train: 32 independent worlds, 8A 8B 8A 8B latent order hidden from all learners; 4 noisy actions/world
protocol.test: 64 fresh in-family worlds plus 64 third-operator out-of-family negative worlds; 2 revealed actions/world, evaluate all 6 withheld noiseless bits; zero updates from withheld data
protocol.interventions: uniform without replacement, matched across all fitted arms
protocol.metric: withheld Brier, 0.5 accuracy, novel-operator Brier, serialized cold parity, model size, wall/CPU/peak memory and counted likelihood operations

tuning: Evaluate A exactly once. If credible diagnosable failure, permit one mechanism-targeted change and one independent development split with a new prescore source lock, then stop if still unpromising. B reserve is never a post hoc rescue; original protected Yggdrasil data untouched.
classification: DEVELOPMENT ONLY; no SCIENTIFIC_PASS until separately qualified native first-use with strong matched exact/fully trained controls.
